GALLANTT.NS.d: Gallantt Metal Limited produces and sells iron, steel, and power in India and internationally. The company operates through Iron and Steel; and Power segments. GEMAROMA.NS.d: Gem Aromatics Limited, based in Mumbai and established in 1997, produces and distributes specialised aromatic compounds worldwide. Its range includes clove derivatives such as clove oil and eugenol, mint derivatives including menthol, spearmint and peppermint, and anethole.

GHCLTEXTIL.NS.d: GHCL Textiles Limited produces and sells yarn in India and overseas. Its yarns include vortex, synthetic blended, cellulosic, TFO double, open-end and cotton types. Founded in 1927, the company manages its main operations from Noida, India.

GMRINFRA.NS.d: GMR Infrastructure Limited engages in engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contracting activities in India and internationally. The company operates through Airports, Power, Roads, EPC, and Others segments. It is involved in the development, maintenance, and operation of airport infrastructure and special economic zones; and modernization, maintenance, and operation of international airports on build, own, operate, and transfer basis.

GOODLUCK.NS.d: Goodluck India Limited manufactures and exports a range of galvanized sheets and coils, towers, hollow sections, cold rolled coils, and pipes and tubes worldwide.

HEXT.NS.d: Hexaware Technologies Ltd. provides IT advisory, software development and business process improvement worldwide. It serves travel and transportation, financial services including banking, healthcare and insurance, high-tech professional services, and manufacturing and consumer goods clients. Its application work runs from architecture consulting and new builds to modernization, support, testing and security compliance.

HINDWAREAP.NS.d: Hindware Home Innovation Limited makes, sells and trades building products and consumer appliances in India. Its range includes kitchen chimneys, cooking ranges, cooktops, dishwashers, sinks, water purifiers, built-in ovens, water heaters, air coolers and fans.

INDOWIND.NS.d: Indowind Energy Limited operates as an IPP in the renewable energy sector in India. It engages in developing, setting up, operating, and maintaining wind farms primarily in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka. The company sells its wind power to corporate clients. It also provides project management and asset management services, as well as trades in and sells carbon credits (CERs) in Indian and international CER markets. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Chennai, India.

J&KBANK.NS.d: The Jammu and Kashmir Bank Limited provides various banking products and services for household, and small and medium enterprises in India. It operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Business segments. The company offers various accounts, such as savings, salary, pension, and current accounts; and term deposits.

JARO.NS.d: Jaro Institute of Technology Management and Research Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker JARO and traded in INR. Its country is India.

JYOTISTRUC.NS.d: Jyoti Structures Limited engages in the design, sourcing, manufacturing, supply, construction, and testing of transmission lines, substations, and distribution projects in India and internationally. The company manufactures transmission line, microwave, and wind mill towers; sub-station switchyards; and solar power and rural electrification structures. Jyoti Structures Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

KMSUGAR.NS.d: K.M. Sugar Mills Limited manufactures and trades in sugar and industrial alcohol in India. The company operates through three segments: Sugar, Distillery, and Power Generation. It produces and sells various grades of sugar in jute bags and PP bags; rectified spirit, ethanol, and extra neutral alcohol; and bio fertilizers under the name Moti Super.

LEENEE.NS.d: Lee & Nee Softwares (Exports) Ltd. is an Indian software development and IT services company. It offers software solutions to various industries. The company is based in Kolkata, India.

LINCOLN.NS.d: Lincoln Pharmaceuticals Limited manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. It offers products in the areas of anti-infective, respiratory system, gynecology, cardio and CNS, anti-bacterial, ant-diabetic, anti-malaria, and others areas. The company also trades in pharmaceutical products. Lincoln Pharmaceuticals Limited was founded in 1979 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

MAGADSUGAR.NS.d: Magadh Sugar & Energy Limited manufactures and sells of sugar, molasses, and bagasse in India. The company operates through three segments: Sugar, Distillery, and Co-Generation. It also manufactures and sells industrial spirits, including ethanol, as well as fusel oil and bio-compost products; and generates and transmits power. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

MONEYBOXX.NS.d: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd. is an Indian non-banking financial institution offering lending to micro and small enterprises. Its products include small business credit through the Moneyboxx Vyapaar initiative and property-backed loans branded Saral, and it runs the Sikka App for submitting and tracking loan applications.

NATHBIOGEN.NS.d: Nath Bio-Genes (India) Limited engages in the production, processing, and marketing of hybrid and GM seeds in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Agricultural Activities and Trading Activities. The company offers seeds for cereals, such as maize, paddy, pearl millet, wheat, and jowar; fiber and oil seeds, including cotton, mustard, and sunflower; and seeds for vegetables comprising chilli, okra, tomato, brinjal, bottle gourd, bitter gourd, sponge gourd, ridge gourd, cucumber, and coriander.

NIRAJ.NS.d: Niraj Cement Structurals Limited executes various infrastructure development projects in India. It constructs highways, expressways, turnkey project roads, bridges, tunnels, etc.; and water supply and drainage, irrigation, land storm water drainage, and other infrastructural works.

ORIENTCER.NS.d: Orient Ceratech Limited, headquartered in Mumbai, makes and distributes high-temperature ceramic materials, including refractory and monolithic products. It operates two segments: alumina refractories, monolithics and bauxite ore extraction, and power generation. Its aluminous products include white and brown fused alumina, fused mullite, zirconia mullite, calcined bauxite and chamotte.

PCJEWELLER.NS.d: PC Jeweller Limited manufactures, retails, and trades in gold jewelry, diamond studded jewelry, and silver items in India. The company sells its jewelry through its showrooms and Website, wearyourshine.com. As of March 31, 2020, it had 83 showrooms, including 11 franchisee showrooms. The company also exports its products. PC Jeweller Limited was founded in 2005 and is based in Delhi, India.

PIRAMALFIN.NS.d: Piramal Finance Limited is a housing finance company serving corporate and private customers in India. It offers home, construction and renovation loans, business loans including working capital and loans against property, real estate financing, corporate finance and advisory services. Formerly Piramal Capital & Housing Finance Limited, it took its current name in March 2022.

PRAXIS.NS.d: Praxis Home Retail Limited engages in the business of home retailing through departmental stores in India. The company offers furniture, décor and furnishings, modular kitchen, electronics, kitchenware, and bathroom accessories, as well as customized solutions in kitchen and wardrobes, and interior design consultation and services for homes and offices. As of March 31, 2020, it owned and operated 47 stores in 28 cities under the HomeTown brand name, as well as www.hometown.in, a web portal.

SAATVIKGL.NS.d: Saatvik Green Energy Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SAATVIKGL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SATIA.NS.d: Satia Industries Limited manufactures and sells writing and printing paper in India and internationally. The company operates through Paper, Yarn and Cotton, Cogeneration, Agriculture, and Solar divisions. It offers snow white, super snow white, map litho, colored, ledger, cartridge, duplicating, bond, water mark, and chromo papers for use in the printing of text books, note books, directories, envelops, diaries, calendars, computer stationery, etc.

SBC.NS.d: SBC Exports Limited, set up in 2011, with its head office in Mirzapur, India, operates in several business areas. It makes and distributes hosiery fabrics and apparel (leggings, jackets, trousers, sweatshirts, denims and T-shirts) under brands including SBC DESIGN+, F-ROUTE and IEDEE, trades carpets, and offers information technology services.

SKP.NS.d: SKP Bearing Industries Ltd. manufactures and supplies precision rolling elements, including needle rollers, cylindrical rollers, pins, and steel balls. These components are critical for various industries, such as the automotive, textile, cosmetics, medical device, pharmaceutical, and broader industrial sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, supplying to reputable bearing manufacturers and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

STEELCAS.NS.d: Steelcast Limited, founded in 1960 and based in Bhavnagar, India, manufactures steel castings and sells them worldwide. Its wear- and abrasion-resistant products come in carbon, alloy and manganese grades. They are used in earthmoving equipment, mining, railways, steelmaking, cement, energy, valves and pumps, oil fields and shipping.

SULA.NS.d: Sula Vineyards Limited, founded in 1996 and headquartered in Mumbai, produces, buys and sells wine and spirits in India and overseas. Its range includes white, red, rosé and sparkling wines, and spirits under brands such as RASA, Dindori and York. It also runs wine tourism venues, including vineyard resorts, tasting rooms and restaurants.

SURAJEST.NS.d: Suraj Estate Developers Limited is a real estate developer founded in 1986 and based in Mumbai, India. It focuses on South Central Mumbai, where it builds both residential and commercial properties.

SYNGENE.NS.d: Syngene International Limited, a contract research and manufacturing company, provides drug discovery and development services in India and internationally.

TSFINV.NS.d: TSF Investments Limited, established in Chennai in 1993, operates globally in several businesses. Its core activities are investment management with a focus on the automotive industry, and business processing and support services, including outsourcing for large and mid-sized firms and shared services.

UGARSUGAR.NS.d: The Ugar Sugar Works Limited manufactures and sells sugar, and industrial and potable alcohol primarily in India. The company offers white crystal sugar and its byproducts, including bagasse, filter cake, and final molasses. It also provides various distillery products, such as Indian made liquor products under the Old Castle Premium Whisky, U.S. Whisky, U.S. Brandy, U.S.

USK.NS.d: Udayshivakumar Infra Limited provides infrastructure services with a main focus on road construction. Its projects include national and state highways, district roads, local roads and smart roads built under city and municipal programs. Udayshivakumar founded the company in 1995, and it is headquartered in Davangere, India.

VHLTD.NS.d: Viceroy Hotels Limited is an Indian hospitality company whose portfolio includes Marriott-branded hotels with a convention centre, guest rooms and fine dining, and Courtyard by Marriott hotels offering rooms, banquet facilities and restaurants.

WINNY.NS.d: Winny Immigration & Education Services Ltd. engages in the provision of visa consultancy services to individuals for study, travel, work, business, and migration purposes. It offers training for language proficiency examinations; and consulting and processing a range of temporary and permanent residency visas. The company was founded on June 9, 2008 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

WSI.NS.d: W.S. Industries (India) Limited manufactures and sells porcelain insulators for electrical high voltage transmission, substation, and distribution applications in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Electro-Porcelain Products and Turnkey Projects.
